name: Anoint a figurine with your own blood and then sleep in its presence

system.description: When you **_anoint a figurine with your own blood and then sleep in its presence_**, roll +CON: **on a 10+**, you dream lucidly of the spirit in the figurine, which speaks an archaic but intelligible dialect—it might be persuaded to reveal its name, or the name of its fellow spirit, or the method of calling them forth; **on a 7-9**, you dream of the spirit, but the dream is fleeting, strange, and disorienting—ask the GM what you learn of the spirit.

success.value: you dream lucidly of the spirit in the figurine, which speaks an archaic but intelligible dialect—it might be persuaded to reveal its name, or the name of its fellow spirit, or the method of calling them forth

partial.value: you dream of the spirit, but the dream is fleeting, strange, and disorienting—ask the GM what you learn of the spirit.
